title: Red panda holding a heart
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="glow" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ff5a5a" stop-opacity="0.9"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#c81e1e" stop-opacity="1"/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- tail -->
  <g>
    <ellipse cx="20" cy="72" rx="14" ry="7" fill="#b5341f" transform="rotate(-25 20 72)"/>
    <ellipse cx="15" cy="69" rx="4" ry="2.6" fill="#3a1d17" transform="rotate(-25 15 69)"/>
    <ellipse cx="22" cy="76" rx="4" ry="2.6" fill="#3a1d17" transform="rotate(-25 22 76)"/>
  </g>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="66" rx="22" ry="20" fill="#d9482e"/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="70" rx="14" ry="13" fill="#f2a65c"/>
  <!-- arms -->
  <ellipse cx="30" cy="74" rx="6" ry="9" fill="#c23d24" transform="rotate(25 30 74)"/>
  <ellipse cx="70" cy="74" rx="6" ry="9" fill="#c23d24" transform="rotate(-25 70 74)"/>
  <!-- paws holding heart -->
  <circle cx="34" cy="66" r="4.5" fill="#3a1d17"/>
  <circle cx="66" cy="66" r="4.5" fill="#3a1d17"/>
  <!-- heart -->
  <path d="M50 60 C 47 52, 39 52, 39 58 C 39 64, 50 70, 50 70 C 50 70, 61 64, 61 58 C 61 52, 53 52, 50 60 Z" fill="url(#glow)"/>
  <path d="M43 56 C 43 58, 45 60, 45 60" stroke="#ffd0d0" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="36" rx="24" ry="20" fill="#d9482e"/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <path d="M30 22 L 26 10 L 38 18 Z" fill="#c23d24"/>
  <path d="M70 22 L 74 10 L 62 18 Z" fill="#c23d24"/>
  <path d="M30 20 L 28 13 L 35 18 Z" fill="#f2a65c"/>
  <path d="M70 20 L 72 13 L 65 18 Z" fill="#f2a65c"/>
  <!-- white cheek patches -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="40" rx="11" ry="9" fill="#fbe8d8"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="40" rx="11" ry="9" fill="#fbe8d8"/>
  <!-- eye patches / teardrop markings -->
  <path d="M32 34 Q 38 32 40 40 Q 36 44 32 40 Q 30 37 32 34 Z" fill="#a33220"/>
  <path d="M68 34 Q 62 32 60 40 Q 64 44 68 40 Q 70 37 68 34 Z" fill="#a33220"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="37" cy="38" r="3.2" fill="#2b1410"/>
  <circle cx="63" cy="38" r="3.2" fill="#2b1410"/>
  <circle cx="38.2" cy="36.8" r="1.1" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="64.2" cy="36.8" r="1.1" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="46" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#2b1410"/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="50" rx="7" ry="5" fill="#fbe8d8"/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d="M46 50 Q 50 54 54 50" stroke="#8a2a1a" stroke-width="1.6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M50 49 L 50 52" stroke="#8a2a1a" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- forehead stripe -->
  <path d="M46 20 Q 50 26 54 20" stroke="#f2a65c" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
